record_type_quote: Rather than try to determine how the unusual aspects of Taubert’s [ 33 ] procedure and stimuli may have contributed to the differences between our results and hers, we instead ran a direct replication of her Experiment 2 with new groups of participants.

targets.title: Chimpanzee faces are ‘special’ to humans
targets.evidence_quote: Rather than try to determine how the unusual aspects of Taubert’s [ 33 ] procedure and stimuli may have contributed to the differences between our results and hers, we instead ran a direct replication of her Experiment 2 with new groups of participants.
targets.outcome_quote: Our direct replication of Experiment 2 from Taubert [ 33 ] has produced data that in no way match those reported in that study. There is no evidence from the replication that Chimpanzee faces have some kind of special status for Humans, as concluded by Taubert.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict for the direct replication.

reasoning: Experiment 4 directly retests Taubert (2009) Experiment 2. Other references introduce paradigms or contextual comparisons rather than additional explicitly retested original studies.
